messages.subject: Dynamic data sets
parts:
Hi guys,

I am a ruby developer -- new to R and Shiny. I'm trying to integrate into a ruby application I am building for data visualization, and was a bit confused as to what methods there are for loading data sets dynamically.

Can a Shiny app load data from a sql database? Can I pass a Shiny app a url query string containing a url to a remote CSV file to load in?

eg. myshinyapp.com/?data=http://someothersite.com/2342423.csv

My plan was to host the ruby app and shiny app separately, than simply include the Shiny app inside the Ruby app using iframes.

I'm trying to figure out the best way to share the ruby app's datasets with the shiny app.

I've seen examples in the documentation that load local CSV files, but haven't been able to find examples similar to what I'm trying to do.

messages.author: 549d787393e88f92
messages.subject: Re: Dynamic data sets
parts: I'll add that I expect these to be fairly large datasets, so having the Shiny app load in a remote CSV would not be ideal in terms of load time.
